reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Paul Tudor Jones.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Paul Tudor Jones. Paul is the founder of Tudor Investment Corporation and one of the greatest macro traders of all time. Paul is also one of the most entertaining and interesting people I have ever met.

key_points.text: Paul is the founder of Tudor Investment Corporation and one of the greatest macro traders of all time.
He is full of stories and hard-earned lessons from a lifetime in markets that feels like several lifetimes compressed into one.
In this conversation, he shares how he thinks about trading as a constant battle of risk management and patience.
